# Observability & Automated Provisioning Requirements Quality Checklist

**Purpose**: Deep production-readiness review of requirements quality, completeness, and clarity for automated Grafana provisioning and operational analytics telemetry.  
**Created**: 2026-09-15  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [data-model.md](../data-model.md)  
**Audience**: Author Self-Review  
**Depth**: Deep Production-Readiness Gate  

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.  
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer/author-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.  

---

## 1. Automated Provisioning & Container Lifecycle Requirements

- [x] CHK001 Are file mount paths and target container directories explicitly specified for both datasources and dashboard providers? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Plan §Summary]
- [x] CHK002 Is the behavior of dashboard re-provisioning upon container restart specified to be strictly idempotent? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-002]
- [x] CHK003 Are the exact file permissions, access modes (`:ro`), and update intervals documented for provisioned Grafana assets? [Clarity, Plan §Summary, Research §1]
- [x] CHK004 Does the specification define whether provisioned dashboards should remain editable by operators in the UI? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK005 Are error-handling requirements defined for container startup when the Prometheus backend is temporarily unreachable? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Gap]

---

## 2. Operational Telemetry & Prometheus Metric Specifications

- [x] CHK006 Are metric types (Counter vs Gauge) and metric names explicitly documented for all newly exposed telemetry families? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004–FR-006, DataModel §1]
- [x] CHK007 Are the exact label dimensions and allowable values for `reservation_demand_total` (`day_of_week`, `hour`, `restaurant_id`) specified without ambiguity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, DataModel §1.1]
- [x] CHK008 Are boundary conditions and bucket partition rules for party sizes (1 through 6, and 7+) unambiguously defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, DataModel §1.2]
- [x] CHK009 Are the 3 cancellation category values (`CUSTOMER_REQUEST`, `NO_SHOW_LATE_CANCEL`, `RESTAURANT_INITIATED`) exhaustively defined with mapping rules from domain events? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Research §4]
- [x] CHK010 Is the calculation formula for the platform and restaurant-level cancellation rate percentage mathematically defined? [Measurability, Spec §FR-006, DataModel §1.3]
- [x] CHK011 Are zero-division protections in rate calculations (e.g., clamp_min or fallback when total reservations equal zero) documented? [Edge Case, Spec §SC-004, Contract §3]

---

## 3. Grafana Dashboard UX & Multi-Tenant Filtering Requirements

- [x] CHK012 Are dashboard variable requirements (`$restaurant_id`) with dynamic query extraction and an "All" option explicitly specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, FR-008]
- [x] CHK013 Is the grid layout, panel types (Heatmap, Bar Chart, Stat, Time Series), and panel coordinate positioning defined for all 5 required operational panels? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Contract §3]
- [x] CHK014 Are visual refresh rates and default time ranges (e.g., `now-24h` / `now-7d`) documented in the dashboard specification? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Contract §1]
- [x] CHK015 Does the specification define expected display units and thresholds (e.g., percentage, seconds, counts) for each visualization widget? [Clarity, Contract §3]
- [x] CHK016 Are requirements defined for how panel legends and tooltips differentiate between individual restaurants when "All" is selected? [UX Clarity, Spec §User Story 2, Gap]

---

## 4. Scenario & Cold-Start Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK017 Are display requirements clearly defined for "cold start" environments where zero reservation events have occurred? [Coverage, Spec §SC-004, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK018 Are requirements specified for handling reservations occurring at abnormal or edge service hours (e.g., 03:00 AM or midnight rollover)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK019 Are concurrent status transition scenarios (e.g., simultaneous creation, waiting list acceptance, and cancellation) addressed for aggregate consistency? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK020 Is the expected behavior specified when a restaurant ID provided in a query parameter or variable filter does not exist? [Negative Flow, Spec §FR-007, Gap]

---

## 5. Non-Functional, Cardinality & Performance Rigor

- [x] CHK021 Is maximum allowable metric label cardinality per restaurant quantified to prevent Prometheus memory exhaustion? [Clarity, Plan §Technical Context, Research §2]
- [x] CHK022 Can the first-time dashboard availability threshold (< 5 seconds after startup) be objectively measured in verification? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK023 Can the zero-data rendering target (< 2 seconds without broken panels) be objectively validated? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK024 Is the maximum query latency (< 200 milliseconds for operational periods) measurable via automated tests? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK025 Are role-based access control constraints (restricting metrics to authorized managers and platform SREs) specified for both UI and REST endpoints? [Security, Spec §FR-009]

---

## 6. Dependencies, Assumptions & Traceability

- [x] CHK026 Are Prometheus scrape interval dependencies and OTel collector forwarding assumptions explicitly validated? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Research §1]
- [x] CHK027 Does each functional requirement map directly to at least one testable acceptance scenario in user stories? [Traceability, Spec §User Scenarios, Requirements]
- [x] CHK028 Are Spring Boot Actuator security and management endpoint exposure requirements documented? [Completeness, Plan §Constitution Check, Gap]
- [x] CHK029 Are backward-compatibility requirements documented for existing consumers of the `/api/v1/analytics/summary` endpoint? [Consistency, Plan §Project Structure, Contract §2]

---

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Total checklist items: 29 items across 6 quality dimensions.
